column6: Consent: unnamed trib of Black Brook. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line: the stream from Rochester Road runs north and meets the Rivelin here, 241 m below the plunge pool; the only streams meeting it above come from the south-west and pass no closer than 839 m to the outfall. The nearest drawn link was the Rivelin 709 m away, above the pool.

Consent: Harrow Beck via a surface water sewer. Lazonby's Neighbourhood Plan Design Guide (2018): the main street follows Harrow Beck from Townhead down to the River Eden, nearly 3/4 mile. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws the beck 23 m from the outfall, running north-east, and its last reach meeting the Eden here, 435 m above the Lazonby swim spot; the reach between runs under the village and is not drawn. The nearest drawn link was the Eden 629 m away, 0.3 km above the spot.

Consent: Clifton Hampden Ditch. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws the ditch leaving the works east-south-east (330 m), then after a 160 m gap a further 290 m heading east that stops 82 m short of the Thames. That line, extended, meets the Thames here, 21 m above the Clifton Hampden swim spot's pin; the nearest river point to its end is 7 m above it. Within map precision of the spot, so placed here and counted. The nearest drawn link was an unnamed channel 445 m away, 0.7 km above the spot.

Consent: River Wharfe. The outfall is 5 m from the Wharfe at Wilderness Carpark bathing water point (53.92655,-1.38542). It was snapped onto a 31 m stub of the Wharfe with no network above it, which joins the main channel 43 m below the point, so it was not counted. At 5 m the map cannot say which side of the point it is; an outfall at a bathing water's point counts, so it is placed on the main channel 7 m above it (OS Open Rivers link geometry).

Ilkley Middleton CSO, about 36 spills a year. The EA's bathing water profile for Wharfe at Cromwheel puts it just to the north of the compliance monitoring point, and the EA's own map point for it is 17 m upstream of it. It was snapped onto the next link, 20 m below the point, so it was not counted. Placed on the Wharfe 12 m above the point (OS Open Rivers link geometry), so it counts.

Abbey Mill CSO. The EA's bathing water profile for Nidd at the Lido places it just below the bottom weir, below the bathing water. Snapped 22 m below the sampling point; kept there, so it is not counted (a settled case, which the build's near-spot check would otherwise list).

Stainforth WwTW, 61.5 spills a year (73 in 2025). Its live and annual-return positions are the same point, SD 38199 46710 on the Fylde, 48 km from where Stainforth Beck meets the Ribble; the nearest drawn link there is an unnamed drain 495 m off. Its live receiving water is 'Stainforth Beck a tributory of the River Ribble', and its annual returns for 2022-2025 name water body GB112071065690, Cowside and Stainforth Beck, in the Ribble catchment. So the position is wrong and the water is right. OS Open Rivers draws Stainforth Beck, which meets the Ribble at 54.09768,-2.28034, about 0.5 km below the River Ribble, Stainforth Force pin. Where on the beck the works is was not checked. Placed on the beck's last reach, 30 m above its mouth (OS Open Rivers link geometry): it counts at Edisford Bridge, 43 km below, and not at Stainforth Force, wherever on the beck it is.

Moor Lane PS / Rowton A41 CSO, 11 to 19 spills a year. Live feed and annual return: Caldy Brook. OS Open Rivers draws only Caldy Brook's last 1.6 km, from 53.17584,-2.85289 to the Dee 0.7 km above the Sandy Lane bathing water's pin, so the outfall was snapped 252 m onto the Shropshire Union Canal, a dead end in the network, and counted nowhere. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws a stream 5 m from the outfall running west, then another past Whitchurch Road SPS, which stops 840 m short of the drawn reach under Boughton Heath; that stretch is not drawn. The annual return's water body is Finchetts Gutter, which meets the tidal Dee below Chester weir 5.5 km to the west-north-west; the receiving water and the stream's course point to Caldy Brook instead. Not settled at map precision, so counted: placed 15 m down the drawn Caldy Brook (OS Open Rivers link geometry).

Chester Whitchurch Road SPS, about 13 spills a year. Annual return: Caldy Brook. OS OpenMap Local SurfaceWater_Line draws a stream 1 m from the outfall running west-south-west towards the drawn Caldy Brook, ending 840 m short of it under Boughton Heath. Snapped 155 m onto the Shropshire Union Canal, a dead end in the network, so counted nowhere. Water body Finchetts Gutter, as for UUP00125, which has the same reasoning. Counted: placed 15 m down the drawn Caldy Brook (OS Open Rivers link geometry).

Chester Haslin Crescent, under 1 spill a year. Annual return: Tributary of Caldy Brook. No OS OpenMap Local water line within 412 m (built over or culverted). Snapped 200 m onto the Shropshire Union Canal, a dead end in the network, so counted nowhere. Water body Finchetts Gutter, as for UUP00125. Counted with the other Caldy Brook outfalls: placed 15 m down the drawn Caldy Brook (OS Open Rivers link geometry).
